messages:
sara: Heads up — Okta just flagged a cluster of SSO attempts showing 'credential_fill' behavior. ~130 accounts touched in the last 8m, different IPs but identical user-agent string. excerpt from Okta events: ```
2026-03-20T15:02:10Z EVENT auth.sso.attempt user=alice@redwood.com ip=45.76.23.19 ua=\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT)\" type=credential_fill score=0.94
2026-03-20T15:02:12Z EVENT auth.sso.attempt user=bob@redwood.com ip=18.205.34.8 ua=\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT)\" type=credential_fill score=0.91
...```
sara: Not seeing password-spray patterns, looks like credential stuffing/filled creds from a broker.
mike: Hmm. IPs are geodistributed — EU + NA + APAC within minutes. Could be a credential broker + MFA fatigue attempts. Recommend immediate containment: revoke active SSO sessions for impacted users and block the top 10 offending IP ranges.
natalie: On it. Starting a scoped session revoke for users with event count >2. Command I'm running: ```./tools/okta/revoke_sessions --event-filter credential_fill --since 8m``` will post results here.
sec-bot: Rule "sso:credential_fill:automated" fired 2026-03-20T15:04:01Z, applied temporary denylist to 21 IPs and raised severity to P2.
jordan: Opened incident INC-2026-04531 and notified support + trust@. Recording initial triage there, linking back to this thread. Redirecting all customer-facing comms to the incident PR blurb.
mike: Quick asks — 1) any RBAC changes in the last 24h that could explain lateral access? 2) check KMS audit for unusual Decrypt/Encrypt calls tied to these accounts? If creds were filled they may not have KMS access but we should verify.
natalie: RBAC audit (IAM change log) shows no role grants or policy edits in last 48h. KMS/CloudKMS audit shows only scheduled backup keys used — no user-origin Decrypt calls from those accounts. Attaching logs to the incident: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-04531/logs (will paste extracts once revoke completes).
sara: Good. Also flagging eval for MFA-push fatigue: add a detection when a user gets >3 MFA pushes in 2 minutes from different origin IPs.
mike: Agree. After containment: roll out support playbook, force pwd reset + require device-based MFA for impacted users, and run credential-checks on our staging/service accounts.
jordan: Support banner draft in #support-desk: "We are investigating anomalous SSO activity. If you received unexpected MFA prompts, please deny and contact support." I’ll circulate.
sec-bot: Automated containment summary: 130 users matched, 118 sessions revoked, 21 IP ranges blocked, temporary denylist expires in 24h unless escalated.
natalie: Revoke finished — output: ```revoked: 118 users, failed: 0, blocked_ips: 21``` attaching CSV to incident.
sara: Next steps assigned: mike -> lead post-incident root cause and detection tuning; natalie -> KMS + RBAC verification + artifacts; jordan -> comms and support triage. Please add any other follow-ups to INC-2026-04531. :thumbsup:
